Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the walkthrough yesterday. Procurement at Sterling has a few gates we need to clear before they will accept Redwood as a registered supplier in Ariba:

- Executed MSA + Order Form (we have internal counsel who will redline)
- Proof of SOC2 and Data Retention policy (we can accept a compiled bundle)
- Portal field mapping confirmation (PO line item schema, tax/jurisdiction fields)

Our onboarding team asked whether Redwood can: 1) provide a redlined MSA for our counsel to review, 2) share a one-page evidence bundle (certs + policy excerpts), and 3) confirm the exact PO fields Ariba will require so our SSO and EDI teams can map.

Target timeline from Sterling is: submission by Friday 6/5 so internal legal can review that week and schedule signature next week. Let me know if that is feasible or if we need an extension.

Thanks,

Thanks for the draft. Quick legal notes (high level) after an initial pass:

- Liability cap: Our standard language is reasonable; Sterling may request a higher cap for healthcare. If they push, we should offer a per-claim cap tied to the order form value rather than an across-the-board increase.
- Data retention: the excerpt in the evidence bundle is fine; add the DPA link in the portal submission (I added a note in the docx).
- Audit/invoice access: Sterling's PO team usually asks for invoice/PO acceptance webhook timings — confirm whether Redwood can emit a PO-ACK within 2 business hours of order ingestion.

I left inline comments in Redwood_MSA_Redline_v1.docx (redlines tracked). Attachments still need the final signature block for the Order Form (we should populate the signatory matrix before sending to Sterling counsel).

Jonas — please advise on the following:
1) Can Redwood include a field 'PO.ackTimestamp' in the EDI feed?
2) Do we support sending a separate 'charges' leg (tax breakdown) per line to accommodate Sterling's tax engine?

If we can resolve Jonas's questions today, I can produce an updated redline for Sterling by EOD 6/4.

-Marissa

All — quick ops confirmation after syncing with EDI team:

- PO.ackTimestamp: yes, we already emit an ackTimestamp on ingestion; we can add a separate PO.ackTimestamp field to the EDI envelope for Sterling. Will include mapping name 'ack_ts' in the Portal_Field_Mapping_Ariba.xlsx and push a new version to Kimberly by 10:00 PDT 6/5.
- Tax breakdown: we can send a line-level tax leg (TaxJurisdictionCode + TaxAmount) as part of the PO line list. There is a default behavior that collapses tax into a charge summary; we've agreed to include full breakdown for regulated customers.
- SFTP filename convention: will not change; we will add a gateway rule to accept Sterling's incoming acknowledgment files with their prefix (STERLING_). That will be configured by 6/6.

Next steps: Kimberly, please send the updated redline to Alicia after Marissa's final comments. Alicia — once you upload the evidence bundle to Ariba, please confirm the portal ticket ID and I'll validate the field mapping on my side.

I attached the final evidence bundle we will submit once signatures are complete (evidence_bundle.zip). Kim, I'll prep the DocuSign envelope link for the Order Form and share it in this thread when ready.

—Jonas
